title: Trust The Plan
subtitle: A story about friendship, imagination, and the fear of being left behind.
summary: A narrative-driven video game combining live-action cutscenes with strategy gameplay.
description: Trust The Plan is a narrative-driven video game that combines live-action cutscenes with turn-based strategy gameplay. Between battles, a coming-of-age story unfolds through the characters and their changing friendships.
The project explores how imagination and gameplay can reveal what characters struggle to say aloud. Players experience both the fictional adventure and the relationships unfolding around it.

title: Path of The Stranger
subtitle: Somewhere between adventure and memory.
description: A narrative game where you play as a stranger in a new town. As you learn your way of settling down, you find out that this town is perhaps not as quiet as it first seemed.
